text:
Day 1 of Grok Bot

My favorite setup so far: Intercom + GitHub

Told the Intercom bot: when a PR gets merged, check if it changed the UI or some user workflow
If yes, decide whether the Intercom article needs an update
If there's no article, draft a new one and publish it

It has its own computer
I logged in my Testimonial test account and Intercom admin on it
If it needs screenshots, it opens the browser, grabs them, and drops them into Intercom

Starting today I might not need anyone to keep the Help Center up to date

I just want to build the product
I don't want to babysit help articles
Quite a gift to our devs founders ✌️
